title: Controlled source-retention bundle verification
summary: A private, gitignored and checksum-bound bundle captures the active Amazon research artifacts, Rwanda FDA raw sources and governed derived datasets. Technical integrity and lineage checks pass; a named data owner must still approve the durable evidence-store location and every publication or operational-reuse decision.
storage_location: Default private output declared by data/source-retention-spec.json; raw contents remain excluded from Git.

checks.name: Exact artifact integrity
checks.detail: All 25 retained artifacts match their expected byte counts and lowercase SHA-256 digests; the aggregate bundle digest and manifest digest verify.

checks.name: Private source boundary
checks.detail: The bundle and its raw Amazon and Rwanda FDA source contents are under the repository's gitignored outputs boundary and are not included in this redacted receipt.

checks.name: Rwanda FDA PDF structure
checks.detail: All 13 retained Rwanda FDA PDFs open successfully, report at least one page and have valid PDF signatures.

checks.name: Rwanda FDA visual sample
checks.detail: Rendered first-page samples of the licensed retail-pharmacy register, licensed online-pharmacy register and Kigali duty roster are legible and identify the expected Rwanda FDA source documents.

checks.name: Rwanda FDA deterministic lineage
checks.detail: Re-parsing the retained raw sources produced 2,480 products, 766 retail pharmacies and 3 online pharmacies. The three resulting CSV hashes exactly match the governed derived release files.

checks.name: Amazon research retention
checks.detail: The raw Amazon research snapshot, corrected 2,200-product dataset, consolidated 4,680-record workbook and catalogue-quality overrides are retained with exact digests. This receipt does not grant reuse rights or approve Amazon pricing, text, imagery, ratings or reviews.

checks.name: Approved durable evidence store
checks.detail: The accountable data owner must approve this private storage location or move the unchanged bundle to an approved durable evidence store and record the same verified manifest digest.

owner_action_required: Approve the durable storage location or move the unchanged bundle, rerun npm run data:source-retention:verify, retain the manifest SHA-256, and then complete the separate nine-record data-reuse ledger and signed approval.
